title: TabUnite: An Efficient Encoding Framework for Tabular Data Generation
summary: TabUnite is a research framework and official implementation accompanying a paper on encoding schemes for tabular data generation, benchmarking multiple synthesizer baselines (including a vendored CTGAN implementation) across public tabular datasets. It calls SDMetrics' QualityReport and LogisticDetection for evaluation, and reuses RDT's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers inside its CTGAN baseline's data pipeline.
